archive_type: Source and report archive, not a full experiment backup
selection: Source/report archive; experiment root documents, source, configs, figures, selected small summaries. No raw trajectory datasets, checkpoints, model weights, runtime environments, private infrastructure, or job logs.
omitted_categories: third-party paper full text; references retained

english_documentation.scope: English repository documentation, internal reports, protocols, plans, historical notes, and report-generation text. Scientific results, code examples, and non-text Python syntax are preserved.
english_documentation.source_behavior_scope: Human-readable report text and one display-label field; no training, inference, scoring, or analysis algorithm changes.

validation.credential_pattern_scan: No matches with boundary-aware token patterns

hash_basis: Git blob bytes with repository-normalized line endings; Windows working-tree line endings may differ.
